description: This bar chart, from the paper "Mapping the Minds of LLMs: A Graph-Based Analysis of Reasoning LLM," illustrates the token count for two categories—"Reasoning" (orange) and "Demonstration" (blue)—across different numbers of shots, ranging from 1 to 4, as indicated on the horizontal axis labeled "Number of Shots." The vertical axis, labeled "Token Count," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7000, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 1000. Each bar is a stacked composition, with the orange segment representing the "Reasoning" token count and the blue segment on top representing the "Demonstration" token count. The chart displays five bars: the first bar (labeled "1" on the x-axis) has a total token count of 6393, with the orange portion extending to approximately 6393 and the blue portion on top showing a value of -1952, indicated by a red arrow pointing downward from the top of the blue segment. The second bar (labeled "2") has a total token count of approximately 5000, with the orange portion extending to about 5000 and the blue portion on top showing a value of -1613. The third bar (labeled "3") has a total token count of approximately 6000, with the orange portion extending to about 6000 and the blue portion on top showing a value of -1040. The fourth bar (labeled "4") has a total token count of approximately 6000, with the orange portion extending to about 6000 and the blue portion on top showing a value of -1379. The bars are not sorted and are presented in ascending order of the "Number of Shots" label on the x-axis. The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner identifying the orange bar as "Reasoning" and the blue bar as "Demonstration."
